model_annotations.Bulgarian:
The graph illustrates the changes in the "Max Activation Value" across different layers for four distinct variables, comparing their distributions. The x-axis is labeled "Layer," has a linear scale, and ranges from 0 to 22, with numerical labels at intervals of 5. The y-axis is labeled "Max Activation Value," also has a linear scale, and spans from 0 to 1600, with numerical labels at intervals of 200.

The graph contains four lines, each representing a different variable: "attn_output" (blue dashed line), "attn_residual" (orange dotted line), "ffn_output" (green dash-dotted line), and "ffn_residual" (red solid line). 

The blue dashed line ("attn_output") remains relatively stable around a value of 0 across all layers, with minimal fluctuations. The orange dotted line ("attn_residual") starts at 0, remains low until layer 5, then sharply increases to around 1400 by layer 6, continues to rise gradually to approximately 1500 by layer 10, and remains steady until layer 21, before dropping to around 1000 at layer 22. The green dash-dotted line ("ffn_output") begins at 0, remains low until layer 5, then surges to about 1400 by layer 6, followed by a sharp decrease to around 0 by layer 7. It then exhibits fluctuations, peaking at around 600 at layer 14, before stabilizing near 0 from layer 16 onwards, and finally rising to around 900 at layer 22. The red solid line ("ffn_residual") starts at 0, remains low until layer 5, then jumps to approximately 1400 by layer 6, remains relatively stable around 1500 from layer 7 to layer 21, and then drops to around 500 at layer 22.

Overall, the graph provides a visual representation of how the "Max Activation Value" varies across different layers for the four variables, highlighting their distinct patterns and trends.
model_annotations.Chinese: 该图表展示了基线模型在不同层的最大激活值。图表的x轴标记为“层”，数值范围从0到22，采用线性刻度，刻度间隔为5。y轴标记为“最大激活值”，数值范围从0到1600，也是线性刻度，刻度间隔为200。图表中绘制了四条线：蓝色虚线代表“attn_output”，在x轴范围内保持在50以下；橙色点线代表“attn_residual”，从大约50跃升至约1400，然后在第6层时达到峰值，维持在约1500直到第21层，之后下降到约900；绿色点划线代表“ffn_output”，从第5层开始跃升至约1400，然后波动，在第7层、第14层和第22层达到峰值，最大峰值为1400；红色实线代表“ffn_residual”，从第5层开始跃升至约1500，然后保持在该值直到第21层，之后下降到约450。
model_annotations.English: The plot illustrates the maximum activation value across different layers for four distinct variables: attn_output, attn_residual, ffn_output, and ffn_residual. The x-axis, labeled "Layer", has a linear scale, ranging from 0 to 22 with a tick interval of 5. The y-axis, labeled "Max Activation Value", also has a linear scale, spanning from 0 to 1600 with a tick interval of 200. The plot includes four lines: attn_output (blue dashed line), attn_residual (orange dotted line), ffn_output (green dash-dot line), and ffn_residual (red solid line). The attn_output line remains relatively stable around 50 from layer 0 to 22. The attn_residual line starts at around 25, remains steady until layer 5, then increases to approximately 1400, and further to 1500 at layer 7, remaining stable until layer 21 before dropping to around 600 at layer 22. The ffn_output line begins at around 25, remains steady until layer 5, then jumps to around 1000, followed by a decline to 50 at layer 8; it then exhibits fluctuations, with peaks at layers 13 and 21, reaching values of around 500 and 1000 respectively, before dropping to approximately 600 at layer 22. The ffn_residual line starts at around 25, remains steady until layer 5, then sharply increases to around 1400, reaching a peak of 1500 at layer 7, and remains stable until layer 21 before declining to approximately 500 at layer 22.
model_annotations.German: The diagram displays the "Massive Activation of baseline" across different layers, comparing four distinct variables. The x-axis is labeled "Layer" and ranges from 0 to 20, with a linear scale and tick labels at intervals of 5. The y-axis is labeled "Max Activation Value" and spans from 0 to 1600, also on a linear scale, with tick labels at intervals of 200. The four lines represent "attn_output" (blue dashed line), "attn_residual" (orange dotted line), "ffn_output" (green dash-dotted line), and "ffn_residual" (red solid line). The "attn_output" line remains relatively stable around 50 from layer 0 to 23. The "attn_residual" line starts at approximately 30 at layer 0, remains stable until layer 5, then sharply rises to around 1400 by layer 7, before stabilizing at approximately 1500 from layer 8 to 21, and finally dropping to around 1000 by layer 23. The "ffn_output" line begins at roughly 25 at layer 0, stays steady until layer 5, then surges to about 1400 at layer 6 before dropping back to around 25 at layer 7; it then shows several peaks and troughs, reaching a high of approximately 500 at layer 14 and ending at around 300 at layer 23. The "ffn_residual" line mirrors the "attn_residual" line closely, starting at about 30, rising sharply to 1400 between layers 5 and 7, stabilizing around 1500 from layer 8 to 21, and then declining to roughly 450 by layer 23.
